annotator.notes: Student initially tries to use the starting values instead of the current values. Tutor redirects them to focus on the state after the cards were given away.

task_context.problem_statement:
Nell collects cards. She had 239 baseball cards and 38 Ace cards. She gave some of her cards to Jeff and now has 376 Ace cards and 111 baseball cards left.
How many more Ace cards than baseball cards does Nell have?
( 376.0 - 111.0 )
